sig: Three or more roles at once
ui.tip: Offer a shortlist for the longest open role
ui.opener: I saw your maintenance engineer role has been open for a few weeks. Would a shortlist help?

script.text: Right now, employers near you are struggling to fill roles. Most of them will never call an agency first.
We see it on their own careers pages: roles open for weeks, several hires at once.
NextGen Profit brings these employers to you.
Each lead is ready to call: phone, company email, a short profile and a sales tip written for recruiters.
And it's yours alone. No other agency in your industry gets the same lead.
Every Monday, fresh leads from your towns arrive in your inbox.
One employer with several open roles can mean several placements.
Test it free: ten leads from your area, no strings attached.
NextGen Profit. The right companies, at the right moment.
